title: #441 Persuit of Happiness
prompt: Do you believe that the pursuit of happiness is the most important goal in life?

angles.en: Happiness is found in relationships, not just money.

angles.en: Simple daily activities are a source of happiness.

angles.en: The pursuit of happiness provides a sense of purpose and guides daily actions.

angles.en: Happiness strengthens social bonds and improves relationships with others.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: A good life requires a sense of purpose and stability, as temporary happiness is fleeting and leaves people feeling empty.
